battle.name: 巴克特拉圍城戰
battle.brief: 公元前二〇八年，塞琉古王安條克三世越過興都庫什山，在阿里烏斯河畔的騎兵戰中擊敗巴克特里亞王歐克拉提德斯一世，隨即包圍其都城巴克特拉。圍城歷時約兩年，雙方在城牆與壕壘間相持，安條克西線局勢吃緊後轉為談判，以和約收場。亞述式短柄鐵矛是攻城與守城白刃中最後一線的兵器。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的兩方是塞琉古王國與希臘化巴克特里亞王國。塞琉古方由國王安條克三世親自統帥，他把遠征軍分成中軍與兩翼：中軍是塞琉古式的密集方陣，以長槍、方盾與雙刃劍為骨幹；兩翼是重騎與輕騎，包含御林騎兵（阿格瑪）、鎧甲騎兵與弓箭騎兵；工程人員與工匠隨軍帶著繩索、木料與攻城器械的部件，並負責在河谷中架橋設渡。巴克特里亞方由國王歐克拉提德斯一世直接指揮，軍隊是多族裔的混合體：城邦移民的希臘式方陣居中，巴克特人、索格底亞人與北方薩迦（塞種）部眾組成步兵與弓騎兵，國王親率的騎兵是全軍的攻擊主力。守方以巴克特拉城牆、塔樓與城內儲備為依託，另有扎里亞斯帕的駐軍可以互相策應。第三股勢力只在較古的記載中出現：北方的薩迦與更南的摩揭陀印度，被說成在圍城危急時向巴克特里亞伸出援手。塞琉古方在西線還有安條克王國的亞細亞行省與地中海艦隊，東征本身就必須為西線留出兵力與給養。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Seleucid Empire and the Hellenistic Greco-Bactrian kingdom. On the Seleucid side the supreme commander was King Antiochus III, who led the expedition in person and divided the host into a centre and two wings: the centre was the Seleucid phalanx, built on the sarissa, the round shield and the double-edged sword, while the wings were heavy and light cavalry, including the agema, the cataphracts and the mounted archers. Engineers and craftsmen marched with the army carrying rope, timber and the components of siege engines, and they were responsible for bridging and fording the rivers of the valleys. The Greco-Bactrian side was commanded by King Euthydemus I in person. His army was a multi-ethnic whole: a Greek-style phalanx of the colony towns in the centre, Bactrian, Sogdian and northern Saka (Scythian) contingents forming the infantry and the horse archers, and the cavalry led by the king himself, which was the striking arm of the whole force. The defence rested on the walls, towers and stored supplies of Bactra, with other garrisons at Zariaspa able to support one another. A third force appears only in the older tradition: the Saka to the north and, further south, the Mauryan Indians, said to have reached out to Bactria when the siege stood at its worst. The Seleucid side also had the Asia Minor satrapies and the fleets of the Mediterranean to reckon with, and the eastern expedition itself had to leave troops and provisions behind for the west.
people: 安條克三世是整場戰役的推動者。塞琉古帝國在其父安條克二世手上已失去美索不達米亞與東方行省，他必須在繼承的混亂中重新確認邊界，於是把遠征目標定在興都庫什山以北的巴克特里亞；他不是城下的指揮者，卻把整個帝國的信用壓在巴克特拉。歐克拉提德斯一世是對手，他以少數希臘裔王族在巴克特里亞立足，靠聯姻與分封維持以巴克特人、索加人、塞種人為主的多族裔國家，在阿里烏斯河戰敗之後退守扎里亞斯帕，以城垣與地形拖住塞琉古大軍。歐克拉提德斯的長子得米特里奧斯日後作為使者親赴安條克軍中談判，其舉止與談吐令安條克印象深刻，成為和約得以成立的關鍵人物。留下文字的是波利比奧斯（Polybius），他在《歷史》中記述了阿里烏斯河之戰、歐克拉提德斯的退卻與得米特里奧斯的出使；史特勞玻（Strabo）與查士丁尼（Justin）《Trogo 綱要》則保存了另一套說法，說巴克特里亞曾向印度求援並得象群，圍城最終亦以和議收場。
peopleEn: Antiochus III was the driving force behind the whole operation. The Seleucid empire had already lost Mesopotamia and the eastern satrapies under his father Antiochus II, and the new king had to re-establish the eastern frontier before anything else, which is why he set the objective of the campaign in Bactria beyond the Hindu Kush. He was not the commander at the walls, but he had staked the credit of the entire empire on Bactra. His opponent was Euthydemus I, who had founded a state in Bactria on the strength of marriage alliances and grants of land, holding together a multi-ethnic kingdom of Bactrians, Sogdians and Saka with a small Greek dynasty at its head; after his defeat on the Arius he withdrew to Zariaspa and used the fortifications and the terrain to hold the Seleucid army at bay. Euthydemus's eldest son Demetrius later served as the envoy who went into Antiochus's camp to treat, and the bearing and the speech of the young prince impressed the king so much that he became the hinge on which the peace turned. Polybius is the historian who left us the narrative, recording in his Histories the cavalry battle on the Arius, the withdrawal of Euthydemus and the embassy of Demetrius; Strabo and the Epitome of Pompeius Trogus by Justin preserve a different version, in which Bactria called upon India for help and received elephants, and in which the siege was likewise closed by negotiation.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長矛：短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃的矛，是亞述步兵的標準配備。這種形制的短矛在兩河流域與中亞一線延續了千餘年，到公元前二〇八年仍是希臘化軍隊中近戰兵種的基本兵器——塞琉古方陣中不持長槍的步兵與輕裝兵用它做最後一線的貼身兵器，與弓、刀劍同掛在腰帶上；巴克特里亞一方的索格底亞與塞種步兵則把短矛與弓並用，適合在城牆下與隘道裡短兵相接。與它對位的長兵器是希臘式長槍（薩里沙），由方陣使用，負責在野戰中撐開正面；巴克特里亞騎兵用的是中亞式的長矛（孔托斯）與複合反曲弓，騎在馬上俯射，並在衝鋒時把長矛平端。攻城一方還有繩梯、木製攻具與攻城塔的部件，需要在河谷鬆軟的地層下挖掘地道；防守一方則用城牆、塔樓、出擊的突擊隊，以及石塊與滾木對付。糧秣方面，遠征軍靠巴克特里亞城鎮的徵集，用駱駝隊與馱騾把穀物運到營地；和約中出現的印度象則屬另一條補給線，在較古的記載中由北方與印度運入。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian spear: a short shaft, a long blade, an iron head, the standard arm of Assyrian infantry. The form of this short spear survived along the Mesopotamian and Central Asian line for more than a millennium, and even in 208 BC it remained the basic arm of the close-combat troops of the Hellenistic armies. The men of the Seleucid phalanx who did not carry the long pike used it as their last-line arm in the close fighting, hanging it at the belt together with bow and sword, while the Sogdian and Saka infantry of Bactria combined the short spear with the bow, a pairing that suited the fighting at the foot of walls and in the defiles. The long weapon facing it was the Greek sarissa of the phalanx, which opened up the front in open battle; the Bactrian cavalry used the Central Asian kontos and the composite recurved bow, shooting down from the saddle and levelling the long lance in the charge. The besiegers also had rope ladders, timber and the components of siege towers, and had to drive mines under the soft alluvial ground of the river valley; the defenders answered with the walls, the towers, sortie parties, stones and felled timber. Supply was drawn from the Bactrian towns by requisition and carried on camels and mules to the camps; the Indian elephants in the treaty belong to another line of supply, arriving in the older accounts from the north and from India.
tactics: 安條克進入巴克特里亞的路線有兩條：從巴克特里亞西界渡過錫爾河與阿姆河上游，沿木爾加布河谷北上；或從安條克以東的索格底亞北上，越過興都庫什山的山口。阿里烏斯河一役是騎兵戰，巴克特里亞弓騎兵以連續射擊與迂迴消耗塞琉古的追擊隊，形勢逆轉時，歐克拉提德斯率主力騎兵做中央突破，塞琉古騎兵崩潰，陣地全靠步兵方陣穩住，才沒有被捲入潰散。追擊戰把巴克特里亞軍隊壓回扎里亞斯帕，隨即轉為圍城。圍城的要點是封鎖而非強攻：塞琉古軍在巴克特拉周邊建立營壘，切斷城與北方草原、南方河谷的往來，屯田與徵發解決遠征軍自身的糧食，並逐步向城牆挖掘地道、堆疊柴垛與填土靠近牆根。守軍靠城牆高度、交叉射界與持短矛的突擊隊消耗進攻者，兩年間反覆出城反制，圍城方始終沒有強攻成功。安條克西線的壞消息是決定性的：中亞的僵持與地中海的形勢不能同時兼顧，遠征軍在接近第三個戰役季時決定撤圍，轉為外交。
tacticsEn: Antiochus had two ways into Bactria: crossing the Jaxartes and the upper Oxus and moving north up the Marghab valley, or coming north through Sogdia and over the passes of the Hindu Kush. The battle on the Arius was a cavalry engagement. The Bactrian horse archers wore down the Seleucid pursuit with successive volleys and flanking turns, and when the tide turned Euthydemus led the main body of cavalry in a central break-through while the Seleucid horse broke; the position was held by the phalanx alone, and that is what kept the whole army from being rolled up. The pursuit drove the Bactrians back on Zariaspa, and the campaign turned at once into a siege. The object of the siege was blockade rather than assault: the Seleucid camp was established around Bactra, the lines of communication with the northern steppe and the southern valleys were cut, foraging and requisitions fed the army on the spot, and in time mines were driven under the walls while timber and earth were piled up against the curtain. The defenders used the height of the walls, the crossed firing lines and sortie parties armed with the short spear to wear down the attackers, and came out of the gates repeatedly to check them; over two years the storm was never launched successfully. The news from the west was decisive: the stalemate in Central Asia and the situation in the Mediterranean could not be attended to at the same time, and as a third campaigning season approached the expedition withdrew from the walls and turned to diplomacy.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，但足以勾勒戰役的規模。圍城自公元前二〇八年起，歷時約兩年，至前二〇六年方告結束，中間跨越兩個以上的戰役季節；波利比奧斯與後世記載都把巴克特拉圍城說成一場長期消耗，而不是一次強攻奪城。阿里烏斯河一戰的傷亡，各家記法相差很遠，安條克方面的損失從數千到一萬上下都有說法，巴克特里亞方面的損失相對較小且更難核實；較為可靠的是結果本身：騎兵戰、步兵方陣未崩、國王退入城內。兵員總數沒有可信記載，塞琉古遠征軍通常被推測在數萬人量級，巴克特里亞軍隊因多族裔徵召同樣沒有定數；和約中唯一明確的數量是象，查士丁尼記為一百頭。時序上，阿里烏斯河之戰在先、圍城在後，古籍一致；圍城的確切月份沒有留下記載，通行做法是置於春季戰役季初。
dataEn: Little can be checked, but what there is fixes the scale of the operation. The siege began in 208 BC, ran for about two years and ended in 206 BC, so it spanned more than two campaigning seasons; Polybius and the later writers alike describe the siege of Bactra as a long attritional struggle rather than a storm. The casualty figures of the battle on the Arius vary widely from one author to another: the Seleucid losses are put at some thousands, at most in the region of ten thousand, while the Bactrian losses are given as smaller and are harder to verify. The more reliable part of the account is the result itself, a cavalry action in which the phalanx did not break and the king fell back inside his own city. No reliable figure survives for the size of the armies: the Seleucid expedition is usually reckoned in the tens of thousands, and the Bactrian host, raised from several peoples, is equally uncertain. The one explicit number in the treaty is the elephants, a hundred of them in Justin. As to sequence, the ancient accounts agree that the battle on the Arius came first and the siege followed; the month of the siege is not recorded, and it is conventional to place it at the opening of the spring campaigning season.
cause: 巴克特里亞之所以要打，起因有兩層。第一層是塞琉古帝國的崩解與收復：安條克二世之後，塞琉古的東方行省先後脫離，歐克拉提德斯在公元前二五〇年前後奪取巴克特里亞與索格底亞，建立希臘化巴克特里亞王國，與北方的安息分庭抗禮；安條克三世登基後必須把這些行省拿回來，否則帝國在東線只剩地中海。第二層是貿易與邊界：巴克特里亞是通往印度與中亞的門戶，塞琉古的絲綢與棉貨商路，以及高加索與興都庫什之間的邊境稅，都經過這片土地；巴克特里亞的良馬與騎兵同樣是各方爭奪的資源。至於安條克本人，這是他登基後第一場大規模遠征，關係到他在繼承的內鬥之後能否讓東方行省承認他的權力，因此不能接受一個由他臣下的臣下所建的王國留在邊上。
causeEn: There are two layers to the reason Bactria had to be fought over. The first is the fragmentation of the Seleucid empire and the attempt to reconquer it: after Antiochus II the eastern satrapies had slipped away one after another, and around 250 BC Eucratides took Bactria and Sogdia and founded the Hellenistic Greco-Bactrian kingdom, which held its own against Parthia in the east. Antiochus III had to win those satrapies back, or the empire would keep nothing beyond the Mediterranean. The second layer is trade and frontier: Bactria was the gateway to India and Central Asia, and the Seleucid silk and cotton routes, together with the frontier dues between the Caucasus and the Hindu Kush, all ran through that country; Bactrian horses and Bactrian cavalry were resources in their own right. As for Antiochus himself, this was the first large expedition of his reign, and it bore on the question of whether the eastern satrapies would accept his authority after the disorders of the succession. A kingdom founded by a subject of his own subjects could not be left on the frontier.
impact: 圍城的結果是承認既成事實。安條克承認歐克拉提德斯一世的王號，與其長子得米特里奧斯聯姻，於是巴克特里亞以一個獨立的希臘化王國留在塞琉古帝國的東面，成為帝國與安息、塞種草原之間的一層緩衝。這個安排維持了將近一個半世紀，直到巴克特里亞先後被北方草原民族與貴霜壓倒，塞琉古的邊界退到興都庫什山一線，和約的成果才最終消散。另一項影響在軍事編制上：和約中轉交的印度象，波利比奧斯認為安條克把它與自己原有的象群合併，此後的塞琉古象軍在編制上更為完整，這支部隊在三十年後的馬格尼西亞會戰仍然出戰。大陸上，兩河流域與呼羅珊之間的東線第一次長期由一個有希臘化城邦骨幹的王國承擔前沿，這也是希臘化的巴克特里亞在後來的中亞政治裡保住相當獨立性的原因之一。
impactEn: The outcome of the siege was the recognition of accomplished fact. Antiochus conceded the royal title to Euthydemus I and married his own daughter to Demetrius, and Bactria therefore remained a separate Hellenistic kingdom on the eastern face of the Seleucid empire, a buffer between the empire, Parthia and the Saka steppe. The arrangement held for close to a century and a half, until Bactria was pressed in turn by peoples of the northern steppe and by the Kushans, the Seleucid frontier fell back to the line of the Hindu Kush, and only then did the results of the treaty finally dissolve. The second effect was one of military organisation: the elephants transferred in the treaty, which Polybius takes to have been added to Antiochus's own herds, completed the Seleucid elephant corps, and that corps was still in the field at Magnesia thirty years later. On the continent, the eastern line between Mesopotamia and Khurasan was for the first time held for a long time by a state with a Hellenistic civic core, and that is part of the reason why Hellenistic Bactria preserved a considerable independence in the later politics of Central Asia.
result: 巴克特拉沒有被攻破。圍城持續約兩年，塞琉古軍隊始終未能強破城牆，防守方也沒有反敗為勝奪回城外陣地，局勢在僵持中維持。安條克得到西線惡耗後放棄強攻，撤圍並轉向外交；他接見了歐克拉提德斯的使者得米特里奧斯，許諾以己女許配，承認其父的王者身分，雙方因而議和。條約內容以古記所載者為準：歐克拉提德斯獲得塞琉古方面的王號承認，得米特里奧斯迎娶安條克之女，並向安條克交付象群。圍城結束後，希臘化巴克特里亞王國繼續存在，巴克特拉仍是它的都城，國王仍是歐克拉提德斯一世的後裔；塞琉古帝國則把東線的界線畫在興都庫什山，暫時承認這條界線。圍城沒有改變巴克特里亞的獨立，卻把巴克特里亞與塞琉古之間的關係從臣屬改成了由聯姻加封的對等盟友。
resultEn: Bactra was never taken. The siege lasted about two years; the Seleucid army could not break the walls, and the defenders could not take back the ground outside the gates either, and the position remained a stalemate. When bad news came from the west, Antiochus gave up the assault, lifted the siege and turned to diplomacy. He received Euthydemus's envoy Demetrius, promised him one of his own daughters, conceded his father's royal title, and a peace was concluded on that basis. The terms as the ancient writers record them are: Euthydemus received recognition of his royal title from Antiochus, Demetrius married a daughter of the king, and elephants were handed over to Antiochus. After the siege the Hellenistic Greco-Bactrian kingdom went on existing, Bactra remained its capital and the king was a descendant of Euthydemus I; the Seleucid empire drew its eastern line at the Hindu Kush and for the time accepted that line. The siege changed nothing about Bactrian independence, but it turned the relationship between Bactria and the empire from one of subjection into an equal alliance sealed by marriage and grant.
